pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped, non-geometric dark regions with soft-edge gradients. Spatial area is heterogeneous, with larger, more contiguous patches on the mid-flank and smaller, more fragmented, lobed patches appearing toward the ventral and posterior margins.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous topological graph of light-pigmented negative space. Junction nodes are primarily tri-radial and quad-radial. Pixel thickness of pathways is narrowest on the dorsal-neck region and widens significantly on the lower flank and hindquarters.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrated contour along the visible dorsal neck. Individual hair tufts create a fine-grained, jagged silhouette against the background sky.
